title: Spike: real hook ancestry for Claude and Codex
description: Register a logging hook (via claude --settings / a temporary CODEX_HOME, never editing ~/.claude or ~/.codex) and record proc_pidpath(getppid()) plus the full ancestor chain (pid, ppid, exe, argv) for one Claude SessionStart and one tool event, and for Codex with the shared app-server daemon and with --no-daemon, on macOS. Record whether the harness process is reachable within 6 ancestor levels and how it is recognized (native binary, node wrapper, daemon). owns: docs/compatibility note on hook ancestry. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md (Attribution).
acceptance_criteria: Ancestry for each configuration recorded in docs/compatibility; a stated verdict per configuration (recognizable within 6 levels or not) that ht-xoc.2 implements against.

title: Integration sweep: harness version evidence end to end
description:
End to end with a stand-in harness: an unlisted new version -> no Health line -> first lifecycle + tool payloads -> working; a payload missing a required field -> degraded with the 'upgrade herdr-threads to X' action from a fake manifest; manifest known_broken for an unseen version -> broken with action; a version verified here stays working despite a manifest known_broken (doctor note only); offline / opt-out paths produce no fetch. Fix small gaps inline.

title: Canary manifest writer and harness-manifest branch publishing
description:
Extend B6 canary: write rows to the harness-manifest branch by direct bot commit (contents: write for that branch only); only payload-contract failures write known_broken (with broken_event/broken_field); Tier 0, fingerprint drift, infra, inconclusive, flaky stay issue-only; baseline from the branch file (fallback in-repo); versions.py accepts schema 1 and 2; retention newest 50 per harness + known_broken + listed; fail above 80% of cap; contract_id from 'herdr-threads contract-id' at the tested commit; release workflow embeds the branch file. consumes: contract-id CLI, manifest schema 2. files: .github/workflows/harness-canary.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, scripts/canary/*, scripts/harness-canary-selftest/*.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
blocked-by ht-xoc.1: consumes contract-id CLI
blocked-by ht-xoc.3: consumes manifest schema 2
Canary tests the current main contract and the latest release's contract and keeps one row per live contract.
supported_since: the canary also runs the latest release's contract (via that release's 'contract-id' and parser) against each new harness version and writes supported_since for the release whose contract passes. Manual edits: 'scripts/canary/manifest.py validate|set' validates schema 2 and writes rows with source=manual; the canary never overwrites a manual row. consumes: manifest schema 2 + branch path (ht-xoc.3), contract boundary (ht-xoc.1).
acceptance_criteria: Offline selftest cases: all pass, payload break, known broken persists, flaky, Tier 0 failure -> issue only, retention and size-cap failure, schema-1 baseline upgrade; writer contract_id equals binary's. Writer keeps rows for both live contracts; a client-contract mismatch fixture. Manual row survives a canary run; validate rejects schema violations; supported_since filled from the passing release; release workflow test embeds the branch file.

title: Contract-first state derivation and Health/doctor rendering
description:
One pure function: local violation -> broken; ladder Refused -> broken; local verified -> working (manifest known_broken doctor-only); manifest known_broken (same contract) -> broken; manifest verified or listed -> working; else admitted -> new. Health: nothing for working/new; one degraded line for broken naming harness, version, event, field and action (upgrade herdr-threads to X / pin harness <= last working / issue URL). doctor: one line per harness incl. evidence source, effective fetch policy and cache time. Replaces B6's Optimistic Health note. consumes: ladder classification (B6), evidence rows, manifest model, contract_id. files: src/harness/state.rs (new), src/daemon/health.rs, src/cli/doctor.rs, docs/compatibility/harnesses.md, docs/operations.md.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
blocked-by ht-xoc.1: consumes contract_id
blocked-by ht-xoc.4: consumes evidence rows
blocked-by ht-xoc.3: consumes manifest model
Action selection (R4): 'upgrade herdr-threads to X' when the manifest has a verified row for this harness version under another contract_id with supported_since > the running release (X = that supported_since); else 'pin <harness> to <= Y' with Y = the newest version verified here (local evidence), else the manifest's last_working; else the row's issue_url, else the repo issues URL. Retire noise: inventory every existing version-related Health/doctor emitter (B6 Optimistic note, supported-range / unlisted warnings, harness limitation lines) and remove it or route it through this function. doctor renders the last_unattributed reason from ht-xoc.4. consumes: contract boundary (ht-xoc.1), evidence API (ht-xoc.4), manifest model (ht-xoc.3).
acceptance_criteria: Table test over every input combination; Health shows no line for working/new; broken line carries the right action for each manifest situation; doctor output pinned. No Health line for an unlisted new version with B6's ladder code in place; each of the three action variants rendered; doctor shows the unattributed reason.

title: Evidence store and verified-by-use recording
description:
Migration adding harness_version_evidence(harness, version, contract_id, lifecycle_ok_at, tool_ok_at, violation_at, violation_event, violation_field, last_seen_at); record lifecycle_ok on successful lifecycle check-in; hook sends best-effort non-blocking 'payload ok' note at most once per session while the daemon's reply says unverified; violations reported over B6's parse-failure channel; violation sticky until version or contract_id changes; record nothing when attribution is None. consumes: contract classifier, contract_id; attribution function. files: migrations/, src/store/, src/cli/hook.rs, src/service/dispatch.rs, src/protocol/.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
blocked-by ht-xoc.1: consumes contract classifier and contract_id
blocked-by ht-xoc.2: consumes attribution function
owns: harness_version_evidence schema and read API (verified = lifecycle_ok_at and tool_ok_at both set for the same harness, version, contract_id) and a per-harness last_unattributed(reason, at) record; consumed by ht-xoc.5. Calls ht-xoc.3's ensure_manifest on a first-seen version or a fresh violation.
blocked-by ht-xoc.3: consumes manifest fetch entry point (ensure_manifest)
acceptance_criteria: Tests: verified after one lifecycle + one tool payload; hooks stop sending notes once verified; violation sticks; ambiguous attribution records nothing; migration applies on a populated store. Unattributable payload persists its reason and records no evidence row.

title: Manifest: schema 2, embedded copy, cache and fetch policy
description:
Upgrade B6's in-repo harness-versions.json generator to schema_version 2 (canary-only fields null); embed at build (release: harness-manifest branch file, fallback in-repo); daemon cache in state dir with fetch time + ETag; fetch via 'curl -fsS --max-time 5' only on (a) version with no local evidence and no embedded/cached row or (b) a fresh violation, at most once/day/harness; 256 KB cap; unsupported schema_version -> no manifest; opt-out harness_manifest=off in instance settings or HERDR_THREADS_OFFLINE=1, read at each decision; missing curl = offline. owns: manifest model, loader, fetch policy. files: src/harness/manifest.rs (new), build.rs or include_str embed, src/daemon settings, docs/compatibility/harness-versions.json.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
Rows keyed by (harness, version, contract_id); the daemon uses only rows whose contract_id equals its own.
owns: manifest schema 2 row format (rows keyed by harness+version+contract_id; status, evidence, supported_since, last_working, issue_url, source canary|manual), the harness-manifest branch file path and raw URL, the schema_version rule, retention and size-cap invariants; consumed by ht-xoc.5 and ht-xoc.6. Fetch entry point: 'ensure_manifest(harness, reason)' called by the daemon from the recording path (first-seen version with no row, or a fresh violation); the state function (ht-xoc.5) only reads the cached/embedded manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Fake-fetcher tests: triggers only on (a)/(b); once per day; opt-out and offline honored; cache then embedded fallback; size cap; schema mismatch -> no manifest; generator guard test updated for schema 2. A row with another contract_id is treated as no data.

title: Seam contract: running-harness version attribution (ancestor walk, image check)
description:
Seam contract: running-harness version attribution (spec Attribution steps 1-3). Walk the hook's ancestors (<=6 levels) past sh -c, env and runtime wrappers to the first recognized harness process (claude/codex native binary; node running the Claude/Codex CLI script; the Codex shared app-server daemon); read its version from its own executable (--version once per canonical path+inode+mtime, cached; npm: package.json); refuse when the process started before the executable's current mtime (replaced in place); None otherwise, with a reason string for doctor. Inert by default: no caller changes behaviour here.
owns: attribution function and its reason strings. files: src/harness/attribution.rs (new), src/harness/mod.rs.
blocked-by ht-xoc.8: consumes recorded hook ancestry per configuration
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
owns: result type Attributed{harness, version} | Unattributable{reason}; the recorder (ht-xoc.4) records nothing on Unattributable but persists its reason.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: per-version layout keeps A after PATH moves to B; in-place replacement after process start -> None; ancestor walk passes an sh -c hop and a node wrapper; unrecognized ancestry -> None with reason; version cache keyed by path+inode+mtime.

title: Payload contract declarations, contract_id and contract-id CLI
description:
Per-harness contract as data (event kinds consumed, required fields, JSON types) derived from the parsers in src/harness/claude.rs and codex.rs; contract_id = first 16 hex of SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace); 'herdr-threads contract-id [--harness H] --json'; violation classifier (well-formed object, known event kind, required field missing/wrong type) vs malformed/unknown. owns: contract declaration, contract_id, violation classifier. files: src/harness/contract.rs (new), src/harness/claude.rs, src/harness/codex.rs, src/cli/commands.rs.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
owns: the contract boundary consumed by ht-xoc.4, .5, .6: contract_id = first 16 hex of SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, fields sorted per event); stable across builds/toolchains; 'herdr-threads contract-id --json' prints {harness: contract_id} as the machine-readable form. Classifier result: Ok | Violation{event, field} | Malformed (unparseable/truncated JSON, unknown event kind) — Malformed never counts as a violation.
acceptance_criteria: Drift test fails if a parser requires an undeclared field; pinned contract_id test; classifier tests over existing payload fixtures (violation vs malformed vs unknown event). Classifier tests include a truncated stdin and unparseable JSON → Malformed.
